subject: Request to expand demo audience — need to reconvene with security & procurement
messages:
From: Ben Harper <ben.harper@finhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <sam.li@finhealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — confirm July 21, 11:00am PT

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for setting the July 21 demo. Quick update from our side: governance just flagged that Security and Procurement need to join the session to sign off on data residency and contract terms. I copied Samantha (Procurement) — she can pull in the right people. Do you have capacity to extend the session to 90 minutes or should we find a new time that works for more reviewers?

Also worth flagging: our Head of Security (on travel next week) will be in transit July 21–22. If you need their presence, we may need to move to the week of July 27.

Apologies for the late ask — internal review only surfaced now.

—Ben
Ben Harper
Director, Platform Partnerships
FinHealth

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-15T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — confirm July 21, 11:00am PT

Ben —

Appreciate the heads up. We can absolutely accommodate Security and Procurement. Two quick options:

- Keep July 21 but extend to 90 minutes (11:00–12:30 PT). Our product + security cadences can cover the SOC2/data residency items, and Marissa will walk procurement through contract milestones.
- Move to the week of July 27 and include your Head of Security to ensure their availability.

Before I lock anything, looping Marissa and Vivek to check internal availability & whether we should prep any artifacts (SOC2 snapshot, sample MSA redline).

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai

Ava/Vivek — forwarding Ben's note. Quick notes from ops:

- We have a demo slot on July 21 with the AE booked (11:00–11:45). Extending to 90 mins is possible, but resource-heavy: need both Product (Vivek) and Security (Hannah) for the SOC2/data handling segment. Can you confirm Hannah's availability?
- If Head of Security is on travel July 21–22, +Procurement wants to be present, moving to week of July 27 is probably cleaner and reduces risk of follow-up meetings.
- I'll attach a lightweight stakeholder matrix and the current SOC2 evidence snapshot to speed the review. Recommend proposing two alternate windows: July 27 morning PT, and July 29 afternoon PT.

Attachments: stakeholder-matrix.xlsx, SOC2-snapshot.pdf

-Marissa

marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-07-15T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood demo — confirm July 21, 11:00am PT

Looping in my availability: I am booked for travel July 21–23 and can't join that slot. If FinHealth's Head of Security is also travelling then July 21 is risky. I prefer July 27 or July 29 as well.

If we move to July 27, we should plan the agenda like this:
- 30m: Business overview + key use cases (AE)
- 30m: Runtime & infra Qs (Vivek)
- 30m: Security & compliance evidence (Hannah)
- 15–20m: Procurement & next steps (Marissa)

I'll prepare a brief one-pager on data residency and KMS options — will upload to the shared runbook.

-Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

From: Ben Harper <ben.harper@finhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <sam.li@finhealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-17T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — confirm July 21, 11:00am PT

Thanks all for the coordination and the fast turnaround on artifacts. After checking calendars internally: our Head of Security is back the week of July 27 but only available Tues/Wed mornings PT. Procurement can do afternoons, but they're flexible.

Proposed consolidated window: Tuesday, July 28, 10:00–11:30 PT. That hits Security's morning, and Procurement can join remotely. Does that work for your team? If so, Samantha and I will request that our legal lead stay on the line for procurement questions.

If you confirm, I'll send an updated calendar invite and include the internal reviewers.

—Ben
Ben Harper
Director, Platform Partnerships
FinHealth
